newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand sees higher savings level from 1997.
newsitem.headline: Thailand sees higher savings level from 1997.

text.p: Thai Finance Minister Chaiyawat Wibulswadi on Wednesday predicted that the saving level in Thailand will improve from 1997 as a result of several government measures launched in that direction.
Among the measures was a new regulation requiring state enterprises to set up provident funds by September 1997. he told a bankers' luncheon. He did not elaborate.

A poor national savings rates has been cited as a key reason for the widening Thailand current account deficit. The deficit is one of the highest in the region and stood at 8.1 percent of gross domestic product in 1995.
